prompts: Scientific architecture diagram for a medical segmentation research README. Landscape white background, crisp generous labels, flat publication-quality flowchart; blue shared spatial blocks, teal organ token blocks, orange mask readout, purple losses. Title 'OrganSlot E: Cross-Attention'. Draw directed connections accurately: CT 448x448 -> Shared ViT (MAE encoder init) -> z. z -> OrganCollector -> TGEnc -> 20 organ tokens -> LayerNorm + mean pooling -> Query projection + slot identity -> 1 organ query. Separate CT -> Shallow CNN (S4,S8); z and S4,S8 -> Shared pixel decoder -> P4 112x112. Query and P4 -> Query-to-P4 cross-attention + FFN -> Refined query; refined query and original P4 -> Dot product -> Upsample 448x448 -> Final mask loss. A small separate lower reconstruction route branches from organ tokens -> AHER -> Canvas fusion -> Shared reconstruction decoder -> Reconstruction loss. Each organ has its own Collector/TGEnc/AHER, but spatial decoder and query readout shared. No SAM-tail, no coarse masks, no 20-token multiscale attention. All labels English. Footer 'Offline joint training | 20 tokens per organ | 8 organs + background slot'. Do not include metrics or freeze symbols.

Scientific medical image segmentation flowchart, landscape white publication-quality flat layout, blue shared spatial blocks, teal tokens, orange predictions, purple loss boxes. Title 'OrganSlot SAM-tail: Soft Prior + Auxiliary Supervision'. Accurate main flow: CT -> MAE-initialized shared ViT -> z -> OrganCollector + TGEnc -> 20 tokens. CT shallow CNN skip features and z -> Shared pixel decoder -> P16 (28x28), P8 (56x56), P4 (112x112). Token projection + identity -> three sequential refinement blocks 'Read P16', 'Read P8', 'Read P4'. Each block gets respective pixel map. Above these three blocks show repeated rule: 'Before each read: current token mean x current pixels -> coarse logits'; 'detach -> sigmoid -> gate = 0.2 + 0.8p -> log(gate)' feeds attention-score bias into each token-to-pixel attention. Coarse logits also go to 'Upsample logits to 448x448 -> GT auxiliary loss (mean of 3 scales)'. Refined20tokens and originalP4 feed 'SAM-tail: mask token + two-way attention + final token read' -> 'Mask token MLP -> w' -> 'w dot tail-updated P4' -> upsample -> final mask. Put explicit callout 'No coarse-mask prior inside the tail'. Footer 'Segmentation: 0.01 x (L_final + 0.25 x mean L_aux)'. Small separate lower route tokens->AHER->canvas fusion->shared reconstruction decoder->reconstruction loss. Clear arrows and no unsupported extra modules.

Scientific medical image segmentation architecture diagram, landscape white flat publication-quality flowchart, blue shared spatial blocks, teal tokens, orange mask predictions, purple losses, large readable English text. Title 'OrganSlot SAM-tail: Coarse-to-Fine / Downsampled GT'. CT->shared ViT initialized from MAE->z->OrganCollector+TGEnc->20tokens->projection+identity->Read P16->Read P8->Read P4->refined20tokens. CT shallow CNN skips and z->shared pixel decoder->P16,P8,P4 supplying the three reads. No mask bias in those multiscale reads. Refined tokens mean and original P4->'Stage 1: coarse cosine mask (112x112)'. Coarse mask branches to 'Coarse loss' receiving 'GT 448x448 -> nearest-neighbor downsample to112x112', and to 'sigmoid prior (no detach)' -> 'Gate projected V in tail token-to-pixel reads'. Refined tokens and originalP4 -> 'Stage 2: SAM-tail, mask token + two-way attention + final token read'. Gate applies to first and final token-to-pixel reads, not pixel-to-token. Tail outputs 'Mask-token MLP -> w' and 'Updated P4' -> dot product -> 'Upsample 448x448 -> Final loss with full GT'. Include note 'Two decoder stages in one forward pass; not incremental training stages'. Small lower branch organ tokens->AHER->canvas fusion->shared reconstruction decoder->reconstruction loss. Footer 'L_seg = 0.01 [w(e) L_final + (1-w(e)) L_coarse]'. Avoid dense crossed arrows; logical labeled blocks.
soft_prior_revision: Create a clean scientific block diagram on white background, landscape. Title "SAM-tail: Soft Prior + Aux". Use only the following labels and nodes. No CT photograph, no invented tensor dimensions or loss names. Large readable text. Blue boxes shared spatial features, teal boxes tokens, orange boxes masks, purple losses. Main row with exactly these distinct nodes and arrows: "20 organ tokens" -> "Projection + identity" -> "Read P16" -> "Read P8" -> "Read P4" -> "SAM-tail" -> "Mask-token MLP + dot product" -> "Final mask". A separate upper row: "CT" -> "ViT + shallow CNN" -> "Pixel decoder" -> three outputs "P16","P8","P4". Each output connects to its matching Read block. P4 also connects directly to SAM-tail, whose dot product uses tail-updated P4. Below each of the THREE read blocks show a box "Coarse mask from current tokens and pixels". Each coarse mask branches to "Aux loss" and "detach -> sigmoid -> log(0.2 + 0.8p)" back into the matching read as attention bias. Single note "Aux: upsample logits to full GT; average across 3 scales". Lower small branch from original20tokens: "AHER" -> "Canvas fusion" -> "Reconstruction decoder" -> "Reconstruction loss". Footer two exact notes: "No coarse-mask prior inside SAM-tail" and "L_seg = 0.01 (L_final + 0.25 mean L_aux)". Important all THREE sequential read nodes MUST appear: Read P16, Read P8, Read P4. Do not add numeric feature dimensions or examples of reconstruction loss. Keep arrows uncluttered, do not feed aux through detach.
downsample_revision:
Create a minimal accurate architecture flowchart for README, white landscape background, flat rounded boxes blue teal orange purple, English labels only. Title "SAM-tail: Downsampled-GT Coarse-to-Fine". STRICT no additional nodes or labels, no dimensions except stated, no decorative CT photos.
Top pipeline drawn left to right then wrapping if needed: "20 organ tokens" -> "Projection + identity" -> "Read P16" -> "Read P8" -> "Read P4" -> "Refined tokens".
Second row: "Refined tokens" and "Original P4" both feed "Coarse mask / cosine readout". Coarse mask -> "sigmoid, no detach" -> "Tail prior: gate projected V". Coarse mask also -> "Coarse loss", which receives "GT -> nearest-neighbor downsample to112x112".
Third row: refined tokens AND original P4 AND tail prior all feed "SAM-tail: mask token, two-way attention, final token read". Tail -> "Mask-token MLP: vector w" and "Updated P4". BOTH feed "Dot product" -> "Upsample448x448" -> "Final loss with full GT".
Bottom annotation: "Spatial source: CT -> shared ViT and shallow CNN -> shared pixel decoder -> P16, P8, P4." Second annotation: "Token source: ViT z -> OrganCollector -> TGEnc -> 20 tokens." Third annotation: "Reconstruction: original tokens -> AHER -> canvas fusion -> shared reconstruction decoder."
Footer: "Two decoder stages in one forward pass, not two training stages." Show P16 P8 P4 read blocks in SEQUENCE, never parallel. w is a VECTOR, not an image. No mask-based attention bias in the three read blocks. Thin clean arrow lines and large readable text.
